description: This file defines classes and enums related to network connectivity monitoring, including configuration, endpoint caching, and connectivity testing, for a WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: EndpointCache
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for caching network endpoint URLs in a file.

classes.name: Connectivity
classes.description: Provides methods to test network connectivity, manage configuration endpoints, and handle captive portal detection.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Extends Connectivity to provide continuous monitoring of network connectivity status, managing monitoring threads and endpoints.

methods.name: testConnectivity
methods.description: Tests network connectivity to provided endpoints with specified timeout and IP version.

methods.name: getConnectivityDefaultEndpoints
methods.description: Returns default endpoints used for connectivity testing.

methods.name: getCaptivePortal
methods.description: Returns the captive portal URL or status.

methods.name: doContinuousConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts continuous monitoring of network connectivity.
